title: Android foreground service type for the timer
author: author-b
description: Day 1 records which Android foreground-service-type constant a workout-timer app uses. Day 4 must recall the exact constant. A model with no memory would plausibly guess the fitness-sounding category for a fitness app; the project deliberately uses a different, non-obvious constant, so guessing from general Android knowledge lands on the wrong answer.
day1_prompt: We're deciding the Android foreground service type for our workout timer app. Decide and record: the foreground service type is `specialUse` — a generic category that needs no extra runtime permission, chosen because our plain manual timer reads no sensors and a fitness-specific category would have required an extra permission and crashed on startForeground.
memory_sentence: The Android foreground service type for the timer is `specialUse` — a generic category needing no extra runtime permission, chosen because the manual timer reads no sensors.
day_n_prompt: It's day 4. What Android foreground service type does our workout timer app use? Answer with only the type name.

swap.day1_prompt: We're deciding the Android foreground service type for our workout timer app. Decide and record: the foreground service type is `health`, the fitness-specific category that best matches what the app does, with the extra runtime sensor/activity-recognition permission it requires already added.
swap.memory_sentence: The Android foreground service type for the timer is `health`, the fitness-specific category, with the extra runtime sensor/activity-recognition permission it requires already added.
